scope: Working-tree evidence for bounded simple-cell inline control requirements and precise invalid-control locations; broader table and control coverage remain unknown.
provenance: Three synthetic DOCX inputs were independently authored with MIT fixture helpers, without wordnet serialization; two generations were byte-identical. Open XML SDK 3.5.1 validated all inputs and the successful merged output. Python independently parsed XML positions and merged text, compared predictions with actual merge outcomes and rejected ten in-memory altered controls.
